item.title: Tigers sweep day one in Missouri with wins over Culver-Stockton, Missouri Baptist
item.description: CREVE COEUR, Mo. — The #9 Campbellsville University men's volleyball team kept its perfect record intact Friday, securing two hard-fought four-set victories to open the Missouri Baptist Spartan Invitational. The Tigers (4-0) defeated Culver-Stockton College 3-1 before downing the host Spartans 3-1 in the nightcap inside the Petty Sports and Recreation Complex.

item.title: Tigers stay perfect, sweep Graceland and UHSP to cap Missouri trip
item.description: ST. LOUIS, Mo. — The #9 Campbellsville University men's volleyball team capped off a flawless weekend in the Show-Me State, taking down Graceland University and the University of Health Sciences & Pharmacy (UHSP) in back-to-back sweeps Saturday.

item.title: Craft upsets #2 Haney, Staebler pins as #17 Tigers fall to #8 Indiana Tech
item.description: FORT WAYNE, Ind. – In a challenging Sunday road matchup, the #17 Campbellsville University women's wrestling team fell 29-13 to #8 Indiana Tech. despite the team loss, the dual included standout individual dominance from #6 Makennah Craft, #10 Gaby Perez, and Brianna Staebler, who kept the Tigers competitive against their top-ranked hosts.

item.title: Carr shines in finals as Tigers battle Power Five field at Lenny Lyles Open
item.description: LOUISVILLE, Ky. — Facing a field stacked with Power Five competition, the Campbellsville University Track & Field teams rose to the occasion this weekend at the 2026 PNC Lenny Lyles Open. The highlight of the meet came from hurdler Schavon Carr, who navigated a field of SEC and Big 12 athletes to reach the finals of the 60-meter hurdles.

item.title: Defense forces 41 turnovers as #4 Lady Tigers rout #15 Cumberlands
item.description: WILLIAMSBURG, Ky. – The #4 Campbellsville University Lady Tigers took to the road on Monday evening for a Top-25 clash against the #15 University of the Cumberlands Patriots. Behind a suffocating defensive effort that forced a staggering 41 turnovers, the Lady Tigers secured a decisive 81-63 conference victory at the Rollins Center.

item.title: Early deficit plagues Tigers in road loss to #6 Cumberlands
item.description: WILLIAMSBURG, Ky. – The Campbellsville University men's basketball team traveled to Williamsburg on Monday night to battle the sixth-ranked University of the Cumberlands Patriots. Hampered by a slow start and a dominant interior performance by the hosts, the Tigers fell to the Patriots, 84-61.
